fusions.name: Blood from the Eyes
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Squirts blood from your eyes in a cone 3 tiles long that deals 8 damage to everything in it, with a 40% chance of [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Venom Jaw
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. Bites it for 25 damage, leaves it 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Poisoned] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: New Tail by Dusk
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: High Noon Rock
fusions.desc: In daylight, your damage rises by 10%.
